origin: Individually authored illustrative paired-rollout summaries; no robot or simulator sampling was performed.
cost_units: illustrative_cost_units; not numerically interchangeable with main-table Cost
geometry_definition: maximum time-aligned planar base-position discrepancy under matched initial conditions and commands, in metres; only the summary is hypothetical, no time series is fabricated
quantile_method: empirical inverted CDF: sorted[ceil(n*p)-1], p=0.9; no conformal finite-sample correction
median_method: mean of two central order statistics for even sample counts
threshold_source: calibration only; alpha=0.18 and delta=0.12 m
coverage_definition: integer count(error <= fixed threshold) / group count
held_out_use: Illustrates application of frozen thresholds; not real independent experimental validation.
limitations: Four published hypothetical calibration anchors constrain this illustrative construction.
Strong positive cost/geometry association and condition-dependent structure reflect authored assumptions, not recovered physical noise.
No raw controller weights, command time series, paired position logs or measured execution costs exist for these records.
Marginal error coverage does not imply joint coverage, navigation success, collision rate or formal safety.
Real replacements require new calibration and frozen thresholds; never force real records to retain hypothetical anchors.
